title: "Are you impressed or a bit worried!?" Tom Holland and Zendaya take Ali Plumb's Harry Potter quiz.
description:
Watch Tom and Zendaya's chat with Ali in full on BBC iPlayer in the UK: https://bbc.in/3rOThNW

Last time Ali spoke to Tom Holland, he said, "I think I know more about Harry Potter than JK Rowling!" So, Ali puts him and Zendaya to the test with a very special Harry Potter quiz. See how the Spider-Man: No Way Home stars fare against Ali's fiendish questions, and let us know how you did in the comments.
